title: SmartSim package manifest (schemaVersion 1)
description: Root manifest.json of a .smartsim / .zip simulator package. Only dist/ executes; the entry must be an HTML document inside dist/. Validated server-side on upload; the same rules run in the exam builder.

packageId.description: Stable identity of the simulator across versions (lowercase letters, digits, dashes).

packageVersion.description: Positive integer. Bump for ANY content change: the same version with different bytes is refused.

entry.description: Relative path of the entry document, inside dist/. No '..', no absolute paths, no URL schemes.

responseSchemaVersion.description: Shape contract of the emitted state (v1: bounded plain JSON).
